captions_note: built with CAPTIONS=0, so the reel's own captions run through the wipe in the caption style the buyer picked (the tags stay). Only a reel with no captions at all (caption style 'none') uses this effect's own CAPS words
in_a_reel: build with CAPTIONS=0: the buyer's captions carry the words on both sides of the line. The after look is the grade, the shade and the push-in; raise AFTER_GRADE if the change does not read at phone size
OUT = 'auto' (the look eases off in the last 0.6 s and the slot ends on the plain picture). OUT = None only when the slot ends on a cut or at the end of the reel
start the slot at least 0.3 s before the payoff word and leave 1.5 s or more after the sweep, or the after look has no time to be seen
the two tags say 'before' and 'after' or the buyer's own two words: no claim, number or result on screen that the buyer did not give
steps: run measure.py      # words with measured starts and where the head is, then edit the CLIP block in build.py
run prep_after.py      # ONLY when AFTER names your own file (skip it otherwise): makes assets/after.mp4 and checks it lines up
run build.py SAFE=1 CAPTIONS=0      # prints the wait position, sweep times, caption lines and every warning (!!)
hf snapshot --at 0.1,2.0,3.0      # use your own times: tag in, line waiting, mid sweep, after look
run check.py      # frame count, plain edges, both sides while the line waits, sheet, stills, phone copy

buyer_folder.name: after
buyer_folder.what: optional: the buyer's own finished version of the SAME frames (same take, 9:16, no punch-in or speed change). Empty = the after side is made in the slot
